explanation: A righteous man chosen by God to survive the flood and preserve humanity and animal life.
A large boat built by Noah according to God's instructions, which was to house his family and a selection of animals.
A massive deluge sent by God to destroy the earth and all life because of human wickedness.
The process of removing evil and impurities, in this case through the flood.
Noah's closest relatives who were also saved from the flood and helped rebuild humanity.
Living creatures created by God that were to be taken aboard the ark to survive the flood and repopulate the earth.
Two individuals of the same species, one male and one female, brought into the ark to ensure the survival of the species.
Water falling from the clouds, in this case for 40 days and 40 nights, which led to the flood.
The period after the flood when the waters receded and the earth became habitable again.
